verdict.rationale: GitLab's partner page mentions one-click installation of GitLab Runner into your own Kubernetes cluster, which gives you self-hosted runners for the GitLab CI/CD described in its docs. GitLab can also be installed entirely on your own infrastructure (Linux package, Docker images, Helm chart/Operator), so the whole CI/CD stack can run privately. Missing for 10: first-party runner docs covering registration, executors and scoping runners to projects or groups; detail on running runners on VMs or bare metal; independent or hands-on corroboration that self-hosted runners work as described.
